android.desc:
Turn your Android phone into a powerful SSH client and visual server control panel. Connect to Linux servers, VPSs, cloud instances, and remote machines over SSH, then manage them from one app.

ServerKit combines SSH terminal access with SFTP, Linux server management, server monitoring, Docker, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Kubernetes, AWS, and web server management.

No server agent. No account. Your SSH keys and credentials stay encrypted on your device.

Built for developers, sysadmins, server administrators, and DevOps engineers who need Linux and VPS management from anywhere.

## VISUAL SERVER CONTROL PANEL

Manage common Linux server tasks visually without memorising commands.

🐳 Docker: start, stop, restart, inspect, exec, and view logs
📁 SFTP File Manager: browse, upload, download, edit, rename, delete, and chmod files
🗄️ Database Manager: PostgreSQL and MySQL clients with SQL editor and table browser
⚙️ Services: manage systemd services
📦 Software Installer: install Nginx, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, and MongoDB
📊 Process Manager: view and stop running processes
👤 User Manager: manage Linux users and SSH keys
🔐 Environment Variables: view and edit variables and `.env` files

## SSH CLIENT & TERMINAL

Full-featured SSH client for Android with password or private-key authentication, RSA, ECDSA and ed25519 keys, ANSI terminal support, special keys, Bluetooth keyboard support, multi-tab sessions, port forwarding, SSH agent forwarding, and automatic reconnect.

## SFTP CLIENT & SERVER MONITORING

Browse, upload, download, edit, rename, delete, and chmod remote files with SFTP.

📈 Monitor Linux servers and VPSs with live CPU, RAM, disk, swap, and network usage
🔔 Get background monitoring, custom alerts, and push notifications

## DOCKER, KUBERNETES & DATABASES

🐳 Manage Docker containers remotely with start, stop, restart, inspect, exec, logs, and TLS Docker daemon support.

☸️ Manage Kubernetes pods, view information, and stream logs in real time.

🗄️ Use PostgreSQL and MySQL clients with SQL editors and table browsers. Redis key browser and MongoDB support included.

## AWS & WEB SERVER MANAGEMENT

☁️ Manage AWS EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, ECS, EKS, and CloudWatch from Android with secure credential storage and SigV4 signing.

🌐 Manage Nginx, Apache, systemd, PM2, SSL, Certbot, and Let's Encrypt.

quotes.text:
Problem Statement:
A few months ago, I was outside of my city. I was on a bus when one of my team members messaged me saying users were unable to read the product description PDF. I had to wait 3 more hours until I got back home, opened the laptop, and SSH'd into the server to find out what was wrong. In that moment I realized that being able to manage a server from a phone is very important when a laptop is not nearby.

What it does:
It is a UI wrapper over standard SSH command outputs. It parses the SSH output and shows the results in UI elements, and also translates your actions to relevant SSH commands. This way users won't have to heavily rely on the command line – as we know, typing commands from a mobile device is also hard. However, it also has a terminal to allow you to do anything. It also supports Kubernetes, where you can see and manage pods, view logs and stats, and RDBMS to allow you to quickly perform database operations – a bit like phpMyAdmin or pgAdmin.

Tech Stack: Flutter, SSH, Android Secured Storage, Firebase, Docker

Why Android:
I know – iOS is a major platform for this niche. But for now – as it is an MVP – I have decided to develop for Android to validate my idea and understand if it solves a real problem. The good news is, it does solve a real problem – at least the analytics say so. Within 30 days I got 5 premium users. About 30% of users connect their server and 23% of them use the app regularly. So now I am working on the iOS version.
